purpose: The service tokenizes card numbers (PANs) for other payment services, allowing them to securely handle card data.

components.name: tokenization-service
components.evidence: tokenization-service is a small Go service with two handlers and a worker that rotates data keys.

components.name: vault-db
components.evidence: vault-db (PostgreSQL) holds the encrypted card records and runs as a single instance with a standby.

components.name: vault
components.evidence: Everything runs in the vault private subnet (also called the PCI subnet in Lena's diagrams).

components.name: KMS
components.evidence: tokenization-service -> Vault and KMS: asks for data encryption keys.

flows.data: PAN in, token out (tokenize) or token in, PAN out (detokenize)
flows.evidence: Payment service -> tokenization-service: PAN in, token out (tokenize) or token in, PAN out (detokenize).
tokenization-service -> vault-db: stores the card data in encrypted form.
tokenization-service -> Vault and KMS: asks for data encryption keys.
